_doc: Inputs for credit-review.py decide (credit-trust-decide, trust-yet-verify, captain 2026-10-15 ~22:12Z). Rows of these users/profiles are NEVER provisionally approved by the decider; they get the support request (user_verification_needed) instead. Ids only. There are no named-user rules (captain correction): a high-risk case is caught by the score (big track, conflicts, red flags), never by an id here. Sources: deny_user_ids = credit-authenticity-audit-a1 accounts_ranked_2026.csv actions PULL/HOLD/RE-VERIFY + credit-retro-hold-docfraud-f1 tiers.csv HOLD users; deny_profile_ids = cmux 1346 fleet scan profiles with >= 30% of sampled claims held, plus stillfloo. Adding an id is always safe (it only routes rows to a human/support request); removing one needs Fable or a named admin. editorial_role_terms: claimed roles with a word starting with one of these (Editor, Vocal Editing, Compilation, Pro Tools ...) are high risk; the decider approves them only on trusted catalog confirmation under pop 30 and uvn-under30 never approves them. This file is read by BOTH automations (scripts/credit_review/decide.py and scripts/uvn-under30-cron.py).
